# DefendLua

> Professional Lua script protection with advanced obfuscation, HWID locking, and license key systems for Roblox and Luau developers.

DefendLua lets developers upload Lua scripts and serve them to end users through a protected loader that enforces obfuscation, hardware ID whitelisting, optional license keys, and anti-tamper checks. It supports both Roblox executors and standalone Luau CLI environments.
